mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_EEP_TRADE_CLOSE_M (YM, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{YM}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())

INSERT INTO TB_EEP_TRADE_M (KIND_CD, YM, PARTNER_SQ, PARTNER_NM, TYPE_NM, ITEM_NM, START_DT, END_DT, AMT, MEMO, REPEAT_UNTIL, REPEAT_SRC, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) SELECT T.KIND_CD, #{YM}, T.PARTNER_SQ, T.PARTNER_NM, T.TYPE_NM, T.ITEM_NM, IF(T.START_DT IS NULL, NULL, #{FROM_DT}), IF(T.END_DT IS NULL, NULL, #{TO_DT}), T.AMT, T.MEMO , T.REPEAT_UNTIL, COALESCE(T.REPEAT_SRC, T.TRADE_SQ), T.UPDT_EMPLY_ID, NOW() FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_M T WHERE T.KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD} AND T.YM < #{YM} AND T.REPEAT_UNTIL >= #{YM} AND T.YM = (SELECT MAX(X.YM) FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_M X WHERE COALESCE(X.REPEAT_SRC, X.TRADE_SQ) = COALESCE(T.REPEAT_SRC, T.TRADE_SQ) AND X.YM < #{YM}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_M Y WHERE COALESCE(Y.REPEAT_SRC, Y.TRADE_SQ) = COALESCE(T.REPEAT_SRC, T.TRADE_SQ) AND Y.YM = #{YM})
mapper.select: SELECT PARTNER_SQ, PARTNER_NM, SALE_YN, BUY_YN, USE_YN FROM TB_EEP_PARTNER_M ORDER BY PARTNER_NM
SELECT DISTINCT TYPE_NM FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_M WHERE KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD} ORDER BY TYPE_NM

SELECT D.DEPLOY_SQ, D.STAFF_SQ, S.STAFF_NM, D.EMP_TYPE_CD, D.PRJ_NM, D.START_DT, D.END_DT, D.SALE_PRICE, D.COST_PRICE, IFNULL(D.CLIENT_DIRECT_AMT, 0) AS DIRECT_AMT , P.PARTNER_SQ, P.PARTNER_NM, PD.REAL_SALE, PD.BASE_AMT, IFNULL(C.CLOSED_YN, 'N') AS CLOSED_YN FROM TB_EEP_DEPLOY_R D JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.STAFF_SQ = D.STAFF_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_PARTNER_M P ON P.PARTNER_SQ = D.SALE_PARTNER_SQD.BUY_PARTNER_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_PAYROLL_D PD ON PD.PAY_YM = #{YM} AND PD.DEPLOY_SQ = D.DEPLOY_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_PAYROLL_CLOSE_M C ON C.PAY_YM = #{YM} WHERE D.START_DT <= #{TO_DT} AND (D.END_DT IS NULL OR D.END_DT >= #{FROM_DT}) AND D.SALE_PARTNER_SQ IS NOT NULL AND (D.EMP_TYPE_CD = 'BIZ' OR D.EMP_TYPE_CD LIKE 'EXTERNAL%' OR D.EMP_TYPE_CD LIKE 'ETC%') ORDER BY P.PARTNER_NM, D.PRJ_NM, S.STAFF_NM

SELECT T.TRADE_SQ, T.PARTNER_SQ, COALESCE(P.PARTNER_NM, T.PARTNER_NM) AS PARTNER_NM, T.TYPE_NM, T.ITEM_NM, T.START_DT, T.END_DT, T.AMT, T.MEMO, T.REPEAT_UNTIL FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_M T LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_PARTNER_M P ON P.PARTNER_SQ = T.PARTNER_SQ WHERE T.KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD} AND T.YM = #{YM} ORDER BY P.PARTNER_NM, T.ITEM_NM
SELECT SRC_CD, SRC_SQ, INV_NO, SORT_NO, AMT, ISSUE_DT FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_LINE_R WHERE KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD} AND YM = #{YM}
SELECT ISSUE_DT FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_LINE_R WHERE KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD} AND YM = #{YM} AND SRC_CD = #{SRC_CD} AND SRC_SQ = #{SRC_SQ}
SELECT YM FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_M WHERE TRADE_SQ = #{TRADE_SQ} AND KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_TRADE_M (KIND_CD, YM, PARTNER_SQ, PARTNER_NM, TYPE_NM, ITEM_NM, START_DT, END_DT, AMT, MEMO, REPEAT_UNTIL, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{KIND_CD}, #{YM}, NULLIF(#{PARTNER_SQ}, ''), NULLIF(#{PARTNER_NM}, ''), #{TYPE_NM}, #{ITEM_NM}, NULLIF(#{START_DT}, ''), NULLIF(#{END_DT}, ''), #{AMT}, NULLIF(#{MEMO}, ''), NULLIF(#{REPEAT_UNTIL}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_TRADE_M SET PARTNER_SQ = NULLIF(#{PARTNER_SQ}, ''), PARTNER_NM = NULLIF(#{PARTNER_NM}, ''), TYPE_NM = #{TYPE_NM}, ITEM_NM = #{ITEM_NM}, START_DT = NULLIF(#{START_DT}, ''), END_DT = NULLIF(#{END_DT}, ''), AMT = #{AMT}, MEMO = NULLIF(#{MEMO}, ''), REPEAT_UNTIL = NULLIF(#{REPEAT_UNTIL}, '') , UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE TRADE_SQ = #{TRADE_SQ} AND KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_M WHERE TRADE_SQ = #{TRADE_SQ} AND KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD}
DELETE FROM TB_EEP_TRADE_LINE_R WHERE KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD} AND YM = #{YM} AND SRC_CD = #{SRC_CD} AND SRC_SQ = #{SRC_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_TRADE_LINE_R (KIND_CD, YM, SRC_CD, SRC_SQ, INV_NO, SORT_NO) VALUES (#{KIND_CD}, #{YM}, #{SRC_CD}, #{SRC_SQ}, #{INV_NO}, #{SORT_NO}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INV_NO = VALUES(INV_NO), SORT_NO = VALUES(SORT_NO)
INSERT INTO TB_EEP_TRADE_LINE_R (KIND_CD, YM, SRC_CD, SRC_SQ, AMT) VALUES (#{KIND_CD}, #{YM}, #{SRC_CD}, #{SRC_SQ}, #{AMT,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE AMT = VALUES(AMT)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_TRADE_LINE_R SET ISSUE_DT = #{ISSUE_DT,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE KIND_CD = #{KIND_CD} AND YM = #{YM} AND SRC_CD = #{SRC_CD} AND SRC_SQ = #{SRC_SQ} AND INV_NO IS NOT NULL
